mapper.select: SELECT id FROM training_material WHERE preview_status IN ('PENDING','PROCESSING') ORDER BY id LIMIT 20
mapper.update: UPDATE training_material SET preview_status='PROCESSING',preview_error=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND preview_status IN ('PENDING','PROCESSING')
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM training_material_page WHERE material_id=#{id} ORDER BY page_number
SELECT preview_key FROM training_material_page WHERE material_id=#{id} AND page_number=#{page} AND preview_ready=TRUE
mapper.update: UPDATE training_material_page SET preview_key=#{key} WHERE material_id=#{id} AND page_number=#{page} AND preview_key IS NULL
UPDATE training_material_page SET preview_ready=TRUE WHERE material_id=#{id} AND page_number=#{page}

UPDATE training_material SET preview_status='READY',preview_error=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND preview_status='PROCESSING' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM training_material_page WHERE material_id=#{id} AND preview_ready=FALSE)
UPDATE training_material SET preview_status='FAILED',preview_error='预览生成失败，请重试；若仍失败请联系管理员检查文件和存储连接' WHERE id=#{id} AND preview_status='PROCESSING'
UPDATE training_material SET preview_status='PENDING',preview_error=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND preview_status='FAILED'
